style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Light up your home with pure magic this season thanks to this Christmas tree from HOMCOM. Its artificial design will last you for several years, and it is safe to have in homes with children and pets. It features fibre-optic LED lights for a bright and beautiful look. The branches can support hanging decorations and tinsel for a customised look, creating an extra-special feeling in your home. Beautiful green artificial Christmas tree with hundreds of tiny fibres that dance through the colour spectrum. Multicoloured fibre optics and LED snowflakes on the branches, with a large multicoloured star at the top. Mains-operated tree with a 100–240V, 50/60Hz transformer included. Some basic home assembly is required. The PVC tips are fireproof, making the tree suitable for family use. The base houses a single lamp that generates the stunning, colour-changing fibre-optic effect. Colour: Green. Material: PVC, Plastic. Overall dimensions: 3FT: F45 x 90H cm. 4FT: F60 x 120H cm. Branch tips: 3FT: 90. 4FT: 130. Number of snowflakes: 3FT: 12. 4FT: 16. Transformer voltage: 100–240V, 50/60Hz. Cord length: 1.8m.
